symptoms: Small angular purple-brown spots on leaves
Spot centers drop out giving a distinct 'shot-hole' appearance
Cracked, gummy, sunken pits on peach fruit skins
risk_factors: Sandy soils, blowing rain, and warm humid spring weather
prevention: Plant tolerant peach cultivars; maintain tree vigor with proper fertilization
recommended_actions: Apply dormant copper sprays and early season oxytetracycline applications
